answer: In Proof of Agent, bonded collateral is escrowed per identity, but coordinated equivocation is assessed across the swarm: when k identities sign conflicting histories, the penalty scales as O(k^2), not as k independent fines. Detection also applies an exponential multiplier to capital loss, making sybil control economically fragile. An operator cannot harbor replicas in a cheap haven; even a zephyr-scale attack can exhaust collateral and erase expected gains.
